sourceSentences: Tristana dash [jumps] to the target location. Upon landing, she deals magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Scoring an enemy champion takedown or detonating Explosive Charge [Tristana] at maximum stacks on a champion will reset Rocket Jump's cooldown.
Tristana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
Tristana can still use her abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during Rocket Jump.
Tristana's basic attacks are empowered to trigger an explosion when they kill the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
Explosive Charge can target and damage turrets, and explodes in a larger radius on a turret.

Tristana's basic attacks on-hit and abilities against the target increase Explosive Charge's damage by *100%, stack [stacking] up to 4 times for a maximum *400% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly.
If Buster Shot [Tristana] is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the airborne [knock back] or the 4 seconds expire.
Explosive Charge's cast time is always 100% of the caster's attack windup time.
Reducing Tristana's attack speed via cripple [attack speed reductions] also increases Explosive Charge's cast time by the same fraction.
Explosive Charge's detonation will deal damage to the primary target even if they have become untargetable.
Buster Shot's airborne [displacement] direction is based on Tristana's location at the end of the cast time.
The primary target is pushed in a straight line away from that location, but the knockback distance and speed may be impeded by terrain.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.
For combos, use W and E, switch to Q, and then attack. Next, just attack until the bomb explodes, then use W again to catch up to them.
Your explosive combo is W, then E, then Q, and before the ultimate, a series of auto attacks.
Once you are near the tower, your E and Q will allow you to quickly destroy it.
